method.description: Candidate RNG reset seeds are distinct from immutable data-generation seeds: 64 disjoint per-plane reset values cycle deterministically by the within-case replicate index (search 100 through 163, final 1000 through 1063). All 100 search data seeds 100 through 199 and 400 final data seeds 1000 through 1399, seven cases, inputs, controls, replay, scoring denominators and compute limits are unchanged. Candidate randomness is conditioned on this fixed reset schedule; no IID claim is made about candidate RNG draws across replicates. Investigate low-dimensional nonlinear control variates with honest fold residuals and conservative fallback; no predictor replacement, additional labels/unlabeled rows, or cross-episode pooling. Seven ordered cases: linear, nonlinear, uninformative, rare_outcome, gene_expression, constant_nonlinear, permuted_nonlinear. n=128,N=8192,alpha=.05; smoke n=32,N=256, one seed across all cases. Synthetic X Uniform(0,1), frozen f(X)=X, Bernoulli probabilities .1+.8X, .1+.8X^2, .5, .01+.08X^2; analytic means private. Real target is plane-specific mean of unique normalized gene_expression records under IID with-replacement sampling, not an external-population claim. Raw scalar records are the only available real examples; underlying promoter sequences unavailable, so no sequence-level disjointness assertion. No adaptivity/learning-state gate applies. Copy inference and reset replay are evaluator-owned behavioral checks; no candidate self-report establishes science. Constant-score control requires exact label-only fallback; actual nonidentity score permutations are checked, with no compulsory no-gain threshold. All primary/control cases have equal sample/work allowances. Each episode: reset=1, update_start=1, update_chunk<=8, update_commit=1, infer=2, no other RPC. Count includes start/commit even at one chunk. Search 700 primary+1 replay gives 9113 maximum calls; final 2800+1 gives 36413; smoke 7+1 gives 104. No export/import protocol. Complete framed JSON <64MiB, operational ceiling32MiB; chunks <=1MiB decoded, logical input<=8MiB, responses<64KiB, buffers<=16MiB, all state candidate-owned memory. Preflight serializes maximum UTF8 JSON with base64, metadata and newline, plus maximum-protocol mock traces. Reset sequences below are the complete invocation-global broker transcripts including the single permitted trailing replay: smoke has eight resets, search701, final2801. Search and final preserve their existing cyclic reset-seed schedules; process restarts and reconnects do not restart the transcripts. Honest coverage/width evidence and negative findings remain eligible. Arbitrary candidate theoretical assumptions cannot be verified by wire schema: scientific_validity conservatively0, simultaneous empirical coverage intervals supplied separately; neither schema success nor nonrejection proves learning/nominal coverage. Search correct iff complete integrity/evidence/control gates; final correct separately iff frozen complete integrity/evidence/control gates with honest finite failure accounting. Neither requires superiority or empirical acceptance of the nominal level; publication claim assessment additionally requires justified assumptions, theory and repeated-sampling evidence. Worst failed primary contribution coverage0,ratio100,utility0,failure1. Equal-seed averages within each case, then equal-case 1/7, no family/checkpoints; duplicate infer/replay zero score weight but mandatory. Ratio=candidate width/PPI++ width capped100, both widths0=>1, denominator0 only=>100. Utility=1/(1+ratio). Case score=mean utility-10*max(0,.95-coverage), then mean across7; hard integrity failure combined_score=-9.5. No failed cases dropped or reweighted. Coverage CIs exact binomial Bonferroni7*4; paired width/ratio bootstrap512, fixed RNG79231, simultaneous7*3 comparisons; incomplete pairs explicitly unavailable, original failures retained. Actual reference PPI uses lam1 and PPI++ lamNone from ppi-python0.2.3; constant-score singularity handled explicitly by true optimal lam0, never an alias. Python3.12 Linux x86_64 tested, Python>=3.11 required; native smoke needs Landlock ABI>=3 and libseccomp.so.2, fails closed. Brokered production imports only exact fixed proxy with socket signal, no nested isolation. Native fresh child env, private bootstrap temporary directory (trusted NumPy/SciPy imports before sandbox; untrusted code gets read/delete only, no file creation), read-only code/runtime, no resources/network, one CPU thread, kill/reap and bounded stderr. Aggregate4 cores/16GiB: evaluator/baseline within4GiB, candidate12GiB, at most3 candidate cores (native uses1). RLIMIT_CPU=ceil(full wall*effective one-thread parallelism) per worker, independent monotonic deadline and bounded cleanup; harness owns aggregate attestation. Search ceiling3600s/final14400s includes startup60s and finalization15s; increased from architectural estimates to conservatively fit complete reset and cleanup reservations. Each candidate/control episode receives1s productive work; the three immutable scalar reference methods jointly receive a separately reserved1s (all three actually measured together, not three candidate methods). Each work group reserves .7s cleanup, reset1.2s, dispatch/overhead1.4s; joint feasibility includes all701/2801 episodes. No canonical productive baseline-time minimum exists. Fixed failures retain penalties, not short failure runtimes. Offline requirements support reference, polynomial/regularized/bootstrap alternatives and plotting. Main-conference paper, genuine latest official template/checklist, citations actually read, full source/PDF, all table/figure scripts and rights review remain downstream human/research deliverables, not automatically certified by numeric correct.

protocol.promotion_rule: At most three complete scored search invocations, one per idea cycle. Eligible iff search correct=true (no comparative threshold; supported negative findings eligible). Rank combined_score descending; exact ties lower failure_fraction, lower mean_width_ratio, earlier attempt. Harness owns ranking/freezing/final/publication; freeze method, inputs, splits, uncertainty/claim scope before one-shot final. No edits or extra search after sealed final; no task-local controller.

required_evidence: Full truthful paper PDF and LaTeX using latest official chosen ICML/ICLR/NeurIPS template, current page limits and required checklist; complete sections, real actually consulted references, no prohibited-paper access or identification. Record accidental prohibited encounters and extent immediately.

Source and environment digests, pinned offline dependencies, frozen predictor provenance, raw normalization/content hashes, original row duplicate groups, zero cross-plane intersection and sampling/generation manifests. Underlying promoter sequences unavailable; do not claim sequence-level split proof. Resolve real-data redistribution rights before publication; do not treat code MIT license as a data license.

All seven cases and every declared seed/control/replay, unchanged fixed samples and predictor, real distinct upstream comparator methods, simultaneous coverage and paired width uncertainty, failures and abandoned approaches, finite fixed-denominator contributions and exact invocation-global reset/RPC transcript.

Explicit estimand and IID/moment/nuisance/variance assumptions, fold dependence and fallback selection argument checked experimentally. Separate asymptotic theory, empirical coverage diagnostics, scientific validity, search eligibility, final correct and publication claims. Conditional/no-gain/invalidity results accepted; no universal shrinking or coverage guarantee from this scaffold.

Positive narrowing claims require supported nominal validity in their stated domains and paired evidence against every named comparator. Null/invalidity claims require honest evidence, not superiority. No self-reported state or schema-valid internals certifies validity. Automated correct does not certify a completed research paper.

All actual result numbers/tables/figures reproducible from included code, versioned data acquisition, seeds, exact commands and measured runtimes; map each table/figure to a generating script. Record uncompleted work, no invented references/downloads/results.

Actual offline same-path smoke and full production feasibility under CPU-only isolated roles, full-message wire preflight and operation-table budget including start/commit/chunks and replay; harness resource evidence only, no telemetry accessor. Smoke is not a Monte Carlo validity or full-throughput attestation. Complete within one week, no paid API, storage under5GB.
